listing.name: lpc editor
listing.summary: adds an lpc editor that allows you to edit your wings to put custom weapons on it to edit a wing you need to have a few conditions respected:
listing.aiSummary: Adds a user interface to modify fighter wing loadouts and create new variants using retool chips.

description: Allows players to edit whitelisted wings by swapping in weapons from cargo. New wing variants can be fabricated at the cost of one chip. The editor is accessible via a button on carriers.
